13-10.solution: Together they do \(5\%\) a day. With A at \(1.5\) times B: \(2.5B = 5\%\), so B does \(2\%\) a day and needs \(50\) days.

13-12.solution: A does \(20\%\) in 6 days. B does the other \(80\%\) at \(10\%\) a day in 8 days. Total \(14\) days.

13-28.solution: Together they do \(\frac{50\%}{8} = 6.25\%\) a day and B does \(\frac{50\%}{20} = 2.5\%\), so A does \(3.75\%\) a day. \(75\%\) takes A \(20\) days.
